strategy.entry_signal: 1H EMA20 pullback aligned with confirmed Supertrend (10,3)
strategy.reversal_exit: confirmed 1H Supertrend flip, exit at next 1m open
strategy.stop_loss: 2x ATR(14), with synthetic preliquidation risk guard
strategy.notional_sizing: fixed $10 target margin, 100x isolated research proxy, lot-quantized
strategy.continuity_mode: virtual $1,000,000 research cash to prevent dropped signals; margin budget per trade stays $10; not a usable $100 account PnL
strategy.ETH_points: scaled as entry*BTC_points/80000 rounded to 0.05 ETH tick
strategy.Scalper_offer: 27m waiver hypothetical, independently not verified, not claimed historically
strategy.excluded: real spread, tick fills, exact historical funding payments, exchange mark liquidation, true Portfolio Margin

warnings: Real liquidation and funding payments require exchange mark-price and settlement records; historical FUNDING candles are OBSERVATIONS, not actual realized account funding debits.
Stress assumes 0.01% unfavorable funding at each crossed 8-hour boundary; realized signed funding may differ.
1M historical candles still do not reveal exact tick movement or limit-order fills.
Continuity mode is a research diagnostic to compare all 22 months, NOT the return obtainable with $100 starting cash.
No backtest settings or bots were modified on the VPS.
Scalper-offer simulation is hypothetical; not necessarily available over historical date range.
Slippage stress includes 0.5 BTC and 0.05 ETH points per fill, not actual spread or modeled depth.
Fees and GST follow assumed taker 0.05% each side, GST 18%.
